@Bettina Kroll: I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. I have no scheduling tool here, so nothing will post automatically starting Monday 19 October. I've replied to you in the #coastal-team thread with the details.

What I can do is post the "Coastal week ahead" digest whenever you ask me on a Monday, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reach anyone who can't already see those conversations. Money terms such as rates, prices and contract values will be left out unless Anselm or June approves them, so those items will point to the deal desk.
